text: 🎉 "OH! One more thing! We noticed some of you have been... traveling together! In little groups! How ORGANIC! How INEFFICIENT!"

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Anaconda Empress: Strike the head as it coils. When the coils start to wrap, don't pull away — strike the head and eyes. It will release to protect them. On land it is slow and heavy; it needs the water to be the Empress. Never let it get a second wrap. (You did the thing —

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Murkcap: Stay out of the sporefall. The spores only drift so far and sink in still air. When the gills start breathing, back off and let the cloud settle — then move in while it recovers. Never stand downwind of a breathing cap. (You did the thing — and it worked.)
★ IDENTIFIED: Strychnine Tree. Poison-nut tree (kuchila). The fruit looks friendly. The seeds are strychnine. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — White Noise: Step off the line. When it unfolds, SIDESTEP — it commits to the line and can't correct. Watch the water, not the bird: it strikes where you were standing, never where you are. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Flashbulb Moth: Hit it while it folds. The Wing Flash only fires FORWARD — it must face you. Circle while it folds its wings and hit it before the wings open. It can't flash what's behind it. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Hushpuppy: Wound the lead. Wound the lead and the pack breaks. Hit the FIRST wolf — the one that came in first — and the coordination dies. They fear fire, but breaking the lead is free. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Night Court: Dodge twice. No sound is the tell — watch the ground-shadow. A missed dive comes again instantly at your NEW position: dodge TWICE. Then it's exhausted, and the sky is yours. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Static: Don't walk toward the voice. Resist the lure: don't move toward the crying. Two rounds of refusal and the act breaks — it's a radio, exposed and furious, and it has to re-spool before it rushes. That's your window. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Static Kite: Leave the marked square. The mark is generous — two full beats to leave the square. When it dips to transmit it's at melee height and takes +50%: that's the only window. Leave the square, then punish the dip. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Glasswing Darter: Move when the shadow grows. Watch the shadow, not the bug — when it grows, the dive is coming. MOVE while it falls and it lands on dirt. A missed dive grounds it: that's your window. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Heckler: WAIT to answer back. SHAME is the damage, not the swing — WAIT to answer back and clear it before the HEADLINER pile-on. The words demand a response. Give them one, on your terms. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Cliffhanger: Go for the eyes. When it lunges, strike the EYES or the soft palate inside the mouth — the armored hide shrugs off everything else. Never fight it in the water; that's its studio. On land, get beside it: it turns like a bus. (You did the thing — and it worked.)
🌟 "We have detected elevated attachment to Unit BRASS LOCKET. This is inefficient. This is also... [PROCESSING] ...valuable? Optimization available." (Choose an enhancement for your Brass Locket.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Highbeam Deer: MOVE, don't stare. When it goes still, the beam is coming — MOVE, don't stare at the light. Anything beats standing there: the freeze means it is already aiming. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — tick: Keep two squares away. Keep 2+ squares away and it's harmless — it can't chase. Don't walk up to it. Latched: burn it off with fire, or let it feed full and drop on its own. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Moderator: Wait — silence is a verb it can't moderate. It mutes the verb you lean on — strike or move, whichever you use more. But silence is a verb the algorithm cannot moderate: WAIT and its attention slides off your habits. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Callback: Say the goodbye — properly, out loud. It wears someone you buried. Every few rounds the face shifts and borrows their swing. Speak to it AS them — say the goodbye properly, out loud — and it loses coherence; the face cannot borrow a swing from someone who has been

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — mosquito: Hit it after it drinks. It only drinks adjacent — keep your distance during the dive. After it drinks it's HEAVY and SLOW: that's when you hit it. Smoke and fire ruin its whole plan. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Choir Toad: Break the chorus. The Resonant Croak needs the chorus — every throat in range joins. SHOUT and the note dies mid-croak. The hum needs the choir; scatter the choir. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Paparazzo: Break line of sight before the fourth shot. Four shots is the whole fight — break line of sight before the fourth and the model starves. The EXCLUSIVE cannot be dodged, only prevented: move while the lens steadies. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Lockpick: Buy it off. It steals FIRST and fights second — but it CANNOT resist food. OFFER FOOD in the fight: it drops your things mid-scamper for the meal. A bribe is cheaper than a chase. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Nostalgia: Keep moving during the spell. The Home Movies beam needs your EYES — keep moving during the SPELL beat and the picture can't hold you. The screen burns brightest just before it fires: that's your two-turn warning. Or break its concentration outright: a stun or shout w

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Redactor: Go quiet — starve the redaction. It redacts the loudest thing first, and the handles point a full round before the redaction lands. Go quiet for two turns and its attacks come thin; a third quiet turn starves it out of the fight. (Striking feeds it — every wound ge

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Sunbasker: Never let it finish basking. Its scales go molten gold as it charges — hit it while it basks and the charge dies unspent — a stun, a shout, a thrown rock, anything that breaks its focus. Interruptible: the bask is a ritual, and rituals need quiet. Don't let it finish.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Rerun: Win fast — or write between takes. Every fifth round the take rewinds and it comes back fresh, remembering. Win FAST — kill it within five rounds, the one honest stat check — or leave messages for yourself in the journal between resets: writing persists when nothing e
📖 The memory leaves something behind: Jewelweed — the orange touch-me-not by creeks. Poison ivy’s antidote. The book taught you.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Big-Eyes: Be three tiles out. The bloom is the timer: two beats of brightening, then white. Be three tiles out when it flares. The ember beat after is safe — walk in and finish it while it glows itself out. (You did the thing — and it worked.)
